import os, json, glob
print('ROOT', sorted(os.listdir('.'))[:20])
print('INPUTS', sorted(glob.glob('inputs/*'))[:20])
manifest=None
for p in ['inputs/manifest.json','manifest.json']:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        manifest=json.load(open(p)); break
print('MANIFEST', json.dumps(manifest)[:1200] if manifest else None)
paths=[]
def walk(o):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if isinstance(v,str) and k.lower() in ('path','file_path','local_path','abs_path','file'):
                paths.append(v)
            walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o: walk(v)
if manifest: walk(manifest)
xl=[p for p in paths if p.lower().endswith(('.xlsx','.xlsm'))]
if not xl: xl=glob.glob('inputs/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True)
print('XL', xl[:5])
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(xl[0], data_only=True)
print('SHEETS', wb.sheetnames)
ws=wb['Price history']
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('HDR', rows[0])
data=[r for r in rows[1:] if any(c not in (None,'') for c in r)]
print('NROWS', len(data))
from collections import defaultdict
g=defaultdict(list)
for r in data:
    g[str(r[0]).zfill(6)].append((r[1],r[2],str(r[3]),str(r[4]),r[5]))
for k in sorted(g):
    print(k, g[k])
print('---retail thb covering 2026-11-03---')
for k in sorted(g):
    hits=[t for t in g[k] if t[0]=='RETAIL' and t[1]=='THB' and t[2]<='2026-11-03'<=t[3]]
    print(k, 'hits', len(hits), hits)
print('---retail thb any---')
for k in sorted(g):
    hits=[t for t in g[k] if t[0]=='RETAIL' and t[1]=='THB']
    print(k, len(hits), [(h[2],h[3],h[4]) for h in hits])
wb2=openpyxl.load_workbook(xl[0], data_only=True)
ws2=wb2['Batches']
b=list(ws2.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('BATCH HDR', b[0], 'N', len(b)-1)
from collections import Counter
print('UNIT counts', Counter(r[4] for r in b[1:] if r and r[0] is not None))
ws3=wb2['Pack sizes']
p=list(ws3.iter_rows(values_only=True))
print('PACK', [(str(x[0]).zfill(6), x[1]) for x in p[1:] if x[0] is not None])
ws4=wb2['Material']
mm=[r for r in ws4.iter_rows(values_only=True)]
print('MATERIAL', mm[:13])

notes: Price selection: the request is RETAIL THB valid on 2026-11-03. Valid from/Valid to show two windows (2026-01-01–2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01–2026-11-30); only the second covers 2026-11-03. Caveat: 48 rows = 12 materials × 4, with 36 RETAIL and 12 WHOLESALE, so several materials appear to have more than one RETAIL row inside the November window — if those windows really overlap, which row is effective on 2026-11-03 is unresolved and needs a business rule (latest Valid from, or a data correction).

Currency must be chosen as part of the same filter as the price list, not independently: 36 rows are THB and 12 USD, matching the 36 RETAIL / 12 WHOLESALE split, so THB and RETAIL travel together in this export.
VAT: nothing in the file states whether Selling price is VAT-inclusive or exclusive, so the price should be taken as-is and the VAT treatment confirmed before any vat_adjust is applied.
Inventory grain: Batches rows are material × warehouse × lot (72 = 12 × 2 × 3). Lots must be summed within each warehouse and warehouses kept separate (never 6 lots summed into one figure).

Quantity unit conversion is per product, not global: 48 of 72 stock rows are in CASE and must be multiplied by that material's 'Pieces per CASE' from the Pack sizes sheet (6/12/24 differ by product); the 24 rows in PCS are already individual pieces and must not be multiplied. Ignoring the unit column would over- or under-state stock by up to 24×.
Pack sizes sheet has full coverage: all 12 material codes in Batches appear in Pack sizes, so the CASE→pieces factor resolves for every CASE row; there is no fallback factor.
Lot is not an output field — the target inventory object only holds warehouse_code and qty — so lot is used only to keep the additive rows distinct before aggregation.
Identifiers are zero-padded 6-digit codes (000001…000012) in all four sheets; they must be read as text so the leading zeros survive.

paths=[]
def walk(o):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if isinstance(v,str) and k.lower() in ('path','file_path','local_path','abs_path','file'):
                paths.append(v)
            walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o: walk(v)
if manifest: walk(manifest)
xl=[p for p in paths if p.lower().endswith(('.xlsx','.xlsm'))]
if not xl: xl=glob.glob('inputs/**/*.xlsx', recursive=True)
print('XL', xl[:5])
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(xl[0], data_only=True)

ws=wb['Price history']
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))

data=[r for r in rows[1:] if any(c not in (None,'') for c in r)]
print('NROWS', len(data))
from collections import defaultdict
g=defaultdict(list)

    g[str(r[0]).zfill(6)].append((r[1],r[2],str(r[3]),str(r[4]),r[5]))
for k in sorted(g):

print('---retail thb covering 2026-11-03---')
